create_bernoulli_rbm_transformer: create a BernoulliRBM transformer with configurable hidden units and learning rate for dimensionality reduction
fit_rbm_model: fit a BernoulliRBM model to training data using stochastic maximum likelihood training
transform_data_with_rbm: transform input data into latent representations using a fitted BernoulliRBM model
score_rbm_samples: score samples with a fitted BernoulliRBM to compute pseudo-likelihood estimates
gibbs_sample_rbm: perform one Gibbs sampling step on a fitted BernoulliRBM to generate reconstructed visible samples
